recordedAgainst.note: Two recordings per program. Database ids, uids, operation and index ids, etags, run-window times, the bucket, the project id and its number are placeholders. `second` holds the other recording of rows that differed. A poll row is the collapsed trace of the states it saw and the settled answer (scope decision C10).
